$comment: Rates `npm run voice:cost` prices against. Edit this file when a provider changes its prices; nothing else holds a number. `checked` is when a person last looked, and `confirmed: false` means the rate came from a third-party summary, not the provider's own page. Confirm those on the provider's pricing page before committing money. A rate with `from`/`until` applies only on those dates (inclusive); `voice:cost --on YYYY-MM-DD` picks the day.

speech.$comment: Per-token providers bill the audio they return, so their cost depends on how fast the voice reads. 14 characters a second is an unhurried storyteller reading to an eight-year-old (about 150 words a minute). Gemini counts 25 audio tokens a second.
